scripts.test:engine: tsc src/engine/__tests__/verifyEngine.ts --rootDir src --outDir .dist-test --module commonjs --target es2020 --moduleResolution node --skipLibCheck && echo '{"type":"commonjs"}' > .dist-test/package.json && node .dist-test/engine/__tests__/verifyEngine.js && rm -rf .dist-test
scripts.verify:all: npm run test:engine && npm run test:api && npm run build && npm run verify:playstore
scripts.test:api: tsc tests/apiProxies.test.ts --rootDir . --outDir .dist-api-test --module commonjs --target es2020 --moduleResolution node --skipLibCheck --esModuleInterop && echo '{"type":"commonjs"}' > .dist-api-test/package.json && node .dist-api-test/tests/apiProxies.test.js; status=$?; rm -rf .dist-api-test; exit $status
